name: Ahmad’s companions
goals: Arrange carriage for court requisitions before merchant bookings fill.
Find out which requests will still have the court’s backing tomorrow.
bio: Ahmad’s companions carry his urgent requests to the river. Councillors may back the same defense without belonging to his household or sharing a trade policy.
notes: fact: Brown names Ahmad’s companions, while Pires names the ruler’s son, Tuam Banda and Tuam Mafamut among those against peace in 1511 (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 166–170; Pires II, p. 280)
gameplay: The councillors are affiliated contacts for this episode, not formal members of a standing war party (people-factions.md §3)
